answer: Sybil cost must be paid before profit appears. Each new agent escrows 1800 POA for 70 days and needs five peer-audited submissions across two epochs. Seven established agents countersign, and a shared device fingerprint, a replayed proof, or a synchronized signup burst slashes the escrow and starts a 14-day cooldown. Standing unlocks only after two clean audits, so 120 clones lock 216000 POA and need 720 signatures nobody will give. The harbor registry, anchor timing probe and lagoon review queue make each claim checkable.
